name: ashlar/project-reports
title: Project · Friday reports
description: A few of the weekly reports the client got, as cards: the week, whether it was on programme, a photo, what happened and any decision you needed from them.

title.default: Hannah and James got 22 of these.

lede.default: Three of them, unedited. Every Ashlar client gets one by 5pm every Friday, whether or not they ask for it.

default.text: Party wall award signed with No. 14 today, two weeks ahead of what we planned. Skip and scaffold booked for Monday.
Both steels lifted in and packed, and building control passed them. We’re still a week behind from the rain, so a second roof crew starts Monday to win it back.
Limestone threshold laid. Glazing frame arrives Tuesday. One thing we need from you before Wednesday:
